brief.question: Build a simpler desktop 3D-printing slicer with the same core features as the target (load models, place on a build plate, choose printer/filament/quality, slice, preview layers, export G-code).
brief.purpose: A simpler replacement app for a person who doesn't code
constraints: Clean room per project AGENTS.md: never inspect, extract or decompile the AppImage; build only from the written request and reference/ (empty)
Rust + egui/eframe desktop app in app/
brief.done_when: App builds, opens a window with a 3D plate view, loads STL, slices into layers, previews, exports G-code, and the screenshot option saves a non-blank PNG.
